sprints.title: Foundation, safety and de-risking
sprints.goal: Make the repository trustworthy as the source of truth, remove the credential leak risk, and run the three blocking hardware experiments that determine whether the product's headline features are feasible at all.
why_these: TASK-004 is first because tracker/tracker.ino contained a hardcoded broker credential. Committing that file before fixing it would have put a live secret into git history. The code side is now done and verified across full history; only the broker-side rotation remains, which is a human action.

TASK-019 is the framework decision and it blocks the entire network epic (TASK-101, TASK-103, TASK-104, TASK-108 to TASK-110). Its stated precondition - prove PPP works on this board - is now satisfied, so this is the highest-value task left in the sprint.
TASK-020 is complete: PPP negotiates to phase RUNNING and yields a real IP. See BUG-006 for the three defects that had to be fixed and LESSONS_LEARNED L-11/L-12 for the diagnosis traps.
TASK-021 remains blocked on a physical inspection of the board. No amount of code can settle whether the I2S mic and amp are populated.

TASK-301, TASK-303 and TASK-405 are deliberately NOT in this sprint even though they are P0, because each depends on TASK-019's outcome or on TASK-001/004 completing first. TASK-405 is the natural next sprint: nothing blocks it and it produces the first real end-to-end publish.
out_of_scope: Any NAT routing code (blocked on TASK-019)
Any web portal work (integration surface, but the framework choice is unresolved)
exit_criteria: Repository initialised and committed with a clean history and no secrets  [DONE: TASK-001, TASK-003; secrets scan over full history is clean]
Broker credential removed from tracked source and rotation flagged to the user  [PARTIAL: code done and verified; rotation is a user action, TASK-004 held at VERIFICATION]
ADR-005 framework decision Accepted or Rejected with a written rationale  [OPEN - one of its two preconditions is now met, RISK-002 retired]
RISK-002 PPP on the Airtel SIM produces an IP on the ESP32  [DONE: TEST-020 PASS, phase RUNNING, local=100.76.140.112]
RISK-003 audio hardware population confirmed  [BLOCKED on physical board inspection by the user, TASK-021]
RISK-001 GPS cold start benchmarked  [OPEN, TASK-022]

sprint-002.title: Location service and direct MQTT telemetry
sprint-002.goal: Prove a position end to end and land the first real telemetry from the device to the broker, both on the framework chosen in Sprint 1.
sprint-002.note: Not committed. Depends on Sprint 1 outcomes. If RISK-002 kills PPP, the transport work must use the AT+CIPOPEN path per ADR-004.

next_sprint_proposal.title: First end-to-end product path
next_sprint_proposal.goal: Turn the proven hardware capabilities into one working device-to-broker telemetry path, then decide the framework and start the network epic.
next_sprint_proposal.why_now: Everything in SPRINT-001 that could be settled by software is settled. The remaining sprint-001 items need physical board access. TASK-405 is the highest-value unblocked work because it produces the first real end-to-end publish and retires TEST-403.
blocked_on_user: Rotate the exposed HiveMQ broker credential (TASK-004)
Confirm I2S mic and amp population on the board (TASK-021)
out_of_scope: ESP-SR / voice work until RISK-003 is answered
next_sprint_proposal.note: Not committed to a sprint yet. Listed here so the ordering is visible and reviewable rather than implicit.
